description: Adds property or person IDs to an existing list (max 10,000 per request; duplicates are skipped). Filed records become prospects unless `add_as_prospects` is false. Free; no credits are charged.

add_as_prospects.description: Whether the records also become prospects in the workspace. Defaults to true. Pass false only when the user does not want these records tracked as prospects.

id_type.description: Which kind of IDs these are. Defaults to internal_property_id.

ids.description: Internal property or person IDs to add

list_id.description: The list ID to add to

name: dealmachine_list_add_items
